title: Beautiful, really beautiful, but poor quality.
text: Beautiful, really beautiful, but poor quality.. The seller, I must say, is very efficient and kind on their return/exchange policy.  I had bought the larger size first which I used for a month and liked it so I ordered the smaller size as well.  The smaller one got a huge chip both on the inside and outside (same spot) within ONE use! (preemtive: I have been cooking with enamel for over 45 years, I know how to use it)  the seller was gracious and did an exchange...but the same lower quality of enamel that I'd let them know about the first one (was not soft to the touch and felt and looked as if they missed doing the protective layers on the pot).  I had to send that one back as well.  Sadly, the fist pot I had bought, the only one that was well finished, now also got a chip. Chips on enamel are not a good thing as they usually contiue to deteriorate rapidly (when enamel is substandard quality)...so now I am out my $ and I have zero pots (I am outside of my refund window).
